# The Tech Wolves — Full Content Snapshot

> AI automation and digital transformation studio. Remote-first. Founded 2020. Global team.

## Mission

Senior engineers and designers transforming AI, automation, and product ideas into shipped, scalable businesses.

## Service catalog

### Business Automation
Streamline operations with intelligent automation. CRM workflows, task automation, AI-powered decision systems, n8n orchestration, custom agent design. Saves teams 20–80% of repetitive operational time.

### UI/UX Design
Visually rigorous, user-centric design. Wireframes through high-fidelity prototypes. Usability-tested. Conversion-tuned for landing pages, dashboards, mobile flows.

### Mobile Apps
High-performance iOS and Android apps. Cross-platform builds (Flutter, React Native) that deliver native-grade experiences without the dual-codebase tax.

### Web Development
Fast, secure, scalable websites and web apps. Next.js, React, Node, Python, Go. Static landing pages through full-stack platforms with auth, payments, and admin panels.

## Why work with us

- **Full-stack excellence:** Frontend and backend, end-to-end. Seamless, performant applications from database to UI without handoff seams.
- **Strategic product thinking:** We map users and market to ship solutions that move the business, not just the code.
- **Agile teams:** Lean, fast, pivot-ready — built for startups and evolving roadmaps.
- **Design-driven dev:** Designers and engineers in sync. Pixel-perfect interfaces, usable not just pretty.
- **Transparent comms:** Weekly demos, async updates, always in the loop.
- **Long-term partnership:** We don't disappear at launch. Scale, maintain, improve — for the long run.

Three starting points. Every quote is tailored to scope, timeline, and stack — talk to us for exact pricing.

Essential tools to establish a startup's online presence.

- Hosting (1 year)

- Business email setup
- Basic SEO setup
- 3 months support

### Pro — for growing teams (most popular)
Strong brand identity with a comprehensive online presence.
- Everything in Basic
- Maintenance and support (6 months)

- Analytics + Search Console
- CMS training

### Premium — for scale-ups
High-impact launch with full branding, marketing, and support.
- Everything in Pro
- Full UX optimization, responsive design

30-day money-back guarantee on every tier.

## Engagement model

1. **Discovery call** — free 30-minute consultation to scope your needs.
2. **Custom strategy** — implementation plan with timeline, costs, expected ROI within 48 hours.
3. **Build & launch** — full setup, testing, training to ensure smooth deployment.

Most clients see initial automation results within 2–4 weeks; full optimization within 8–12 weeks.

### How quickly can we see results from AI automation?
Most clients see initial results within 2–4 weeks of implementation, with full optimization achieved in 8–12 weeks.

### What types of businesses benefit most?
SMEs and startups in healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and e-commerce see the highest ROI from our AI automation services.

Yes — 24/7 technical support, regular system updates, and performance optimization are part of our service packages.
